summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Regulatory News Service notice dated 2 November 2026 regarding the allotment and admission to trading of 5,116,320 ordinary shares of 10p each (ISIN GB0008706128) on the London Stock Exchange Main Market, issued between 1 and 30 October 2026 to satisfy awards under the Company's share plans. Shares were admitted under existing block admissions dated 22 May 2025 and 27 May 2026 and are fully fungible; post-issuance share count is 57,262,647,007. This is a routine employee share-plan issuance notification, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
